meanings.asOfUtcMillis: Evaluation instant. Phase intervals end at the cook endedAtUtcMillis when recorded, otherwise at this caller-supplied instant, so active cooks evaluate deterministically.
meanings.channelId: Stable channel identity cookId:probeId-or-probeName:sourceDeviceId:dishId:measurementType:source. A changed probe assignment (same probe, new dish) is a different channel.
meanings.cookAgain: Recorded cook_again choice. Dish-scoped rows win over cook-scoped rows; latest recordedAtUtcMillis wins within a scope; smallest id breaks ties. 1.0 is true, 0.0 is false, anything else is missing.
meanings.cut: Known cut echoed exactly as recorded. Missing stays missing.
meanings.equipmentHeatingMillis: Union of every dish heating interval in the cook. Simultaneous dishes never double-count. Missing when no dish has a heating interval.
meanings.excludedReadings: Readings that never become measurements: qualityStatus other than valid, missing or non-finite value, or a unit outside the temperature set. Counted, never interpolated.
meanings.foodOnAt: First food_on anchor for the dish, ordered by (at, id). Anchors are recorded facts and are reported in every timing mode.
meanings.heatingIntervalCount: Counted cooking/wrapped intervals per dish. Repeated return-to-heat intervals accumulate; missing when durations are missing.
meanings.heatingMillis: Sum of cooking and wrapped phase intervals per dish. Requires timingMode explicit_phases and at least one food_on anchor; otherwise missing. Session creation time is never cooking time.
meanings.holdMillis: Sum of holding phase intervals per dish, under the same requirements as heatingMillis.
meanings.holdStartAt: First hold_start anchor for the dish, ordered by (at, id).
meanings.manualReadings: Valid readings with source manual. Preserved as recorded points; v1 never interpolates across manual gaps.
meanings.maxF: Maximum fahrenheit-normalized value over a channel valid readings. Null when the channel has none.
meanings.methods: Distinct recorded method labels from result rows of type method scoped to the dish or its cook, sorted. No causation is inferred.
meanings.minF: Minimum fahrenheit-normalized value over a channel valid readings. Null when the channel has none.
meanings.rating: Recorded overall_rating if present, else overall. Dish-scoped rows win over cook-scoped rows; latest recordedAtUtcMillis wins within a scope; smallest id breaks ties.
meanings.removeAt: First remove anchor for the dish, ordered by (at, id).
meanings.restMillis: Sum of resting phase intervals per dish, under the same requirements as heatingMillis.
meanings.restStartAt: First rest_start anchor for the dish, ordered by (at, id).
meanings.role: Channel role from the shared role mapping: foodTypes to food, pitTypes to pit, every other measurement type keeps its raw value and is never merged into food or pit.
meanings.units: Distinct original reading units observed on the channel, sorted.
meanings.validReadings: Valid dish-attributed readings (dishId equals the dish). Cook-level pit channels are listed on the cook, not duplicated per dish.
meanings.weightUnit: Known weight unit echoed exactly as recorded. Missing stays missing. v1 never converts or normalizes by weight.
meanings.weightValue: Known weight value echoed exactly as recorded. Missing stays missing. v1 never converts or normalizes by weight.
meanings.wrapAt: First wrap anchor for the dish, ordered by (at, id). Wrapped time counts as heating time.

rules: Session creation time is never cooking time. Durations come only from phase anchors under timingMode explicit_phases.
Missing weight, cut, anchors, results, or readings stay missing. Nothing is filled, defaulted, or interpolated.
A dish without a food_on anchor at or before the evaluation end has missing durations, even when other anchors exist.
Events order by (at, id). Equal timestamps break ties by id, so edited anchors recompute deterministically.
Repeated return-to-heat intervals accumulate per the existing phase rules; each cooking/wrapped span counts once.
Equipment hours union simultaneous dish intervals. Touching intervals merge; overlapping time counts once.
Only qualityStatus valid, finite values in the temperature unit set become channel measurements.
Celsius normalizes as (f - 32) * 5 / 9 and Fahrenheit as c * 9 / 5 + 32, compared within comparedWithEpsilon.
Channels split on the full six-part identity, so a changed probe assignment never merges two dishes curves.
Manual readings stay recorded points. Sparse manual data yields counts and extrema only, never a fabricated curve.
Outputs record calculationVersion. A later version must not silently change an existing free chart meaning.
Comparisons show methods, weights, units, telemetry quality, and coverage next to numbers, without causal or doneness claims.
status: Slice 15 foundation for the PR 17 community engine and PR 18 personal analysis. Existing free charts keep their current meanings.
